measured_not_proved.decoding: Recovering B_+ from a bare c_+ is the Chow-parameters inversion problem and is not implemented. Certificate verification needs no inversion.
measured_not_proved.positive_shadow_alone: That c_+ alone separates distinct normals is measured with zero collisions. T1 gives only that c_+ determines B_+; two normals sharing B_+ but differing on B_0 are not excluded by any theorem here.
measured_not_proved.span_hypothesis: That span(B_0) attains dimension d-1 is verified on every nonstructural survivor of every system audited here, not proved in general.

theorems.T1_determination: Any fixed-weight family summing to c_+(tau) equals B_+(tau). Proved; no threshold hypothesis on the competing family.
theorems.T2_monotonicity: tau_i >= tau_j implies c_+(tau)_i >= c_+(tau)_j, by the exchange injection I -> I minus {j} union {i}. Proved.
theorems.T3_reconstruction: B_0 is determined by the signed pair, and when span(B_0) has dimension d-1 the normal ray is its primitive annihilator. Proved.
